details.effect: Ward. [fanfare] Discard a Levin card: Draw a card. At the start of your end phase, if there are at least 5 Levin cards in your cemetery, give your leader [defense]+1.

issues: Remove "fanfare" from keywords; Fanfare should be encoded as an ability timing, not a printed keyword.

details.effect: [evolve] [cost01]: Evolve this follower. Activate only if there are 5 Machina followers on your field. [act] Banish 2 Machina cards from your cemetery: Summon an Assembly Droid token. Activate only once per turn.

issues: The evolve ability is incorrectly encoded as a no-op passiveKeywords effect; it should encode the actual evolve payment ability/effect for "[evolve] [cost01]: Evolve this follower" with the fieldTraitMin Machina 5 condition.

The activated ability cost is malformed; encode the cemetery banish cost using the implemented activated cost shape with banishFromCemetery filter {"trait":"Machina"} and count 2, instead of unsupported fields "banishFromCemetery" + "banishCount" at the top level.

details.effect: Storm. [act] [cost02], banish an Alpha Drive from your cemetery: Give each Machina follower on your field [attack]+2/[defense]+2 and Rush. Activate only once per turn.

issues: The activated ability cost is malformed; encode the cemetery banish cost using the implemented activated cost shape with banishFromCemetery filter {"identityName":"Alpha Drive"} and count 1, instead of unsupported fields "banishFromCemetery" + "banishCount" at the top level.

details.effect: [fanfare] Summon an Assembly Droid token. Strike - Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it damage equal to the number of other Machina followers on your field. [act] [cost00]: Give this [attack]+1/[defense]+1 and Storm. Activate only if there are 5 Machina followers on your field, and only once per turn.

issues: Remove "fanfare" and "strike" from keywords; these are ability timings and should not be listed as printed keywords.

The Strike damage amount is incorrect; it should deal damage equal to the number of other Machina followers on your field, so the amount must exclude this follower rather than count all Machina followers.
The activated ability is incomplete; it must also grant this follower Storm in addition to +1/+1.

issues: Remove "activated" from keywords; activated is not a printed keyword and should only be represented by an activated ability timing.

The spell effect incorrectly searches by traitsAny for card names; it should summon Queen Hemera the White and Queen Magnus the Black specifically, using identity/name-based filters so both exact cards are found.
The spell effect should summon both named followers, not a single card selected by tutorFromDeck.
The +1/+1 buff should be applied specifically to the summoned Queen Hemera the White and Queen Magnus the Black, not any 2 followers chosen with anyFollower.
The activated cemetery ability should banish this card from your cemetery, so the ability should specify activation from cemetery in addition to the banish-self cost.
